beats.extras: Jordi Puig, 45: a slim white Catalan coach with a short salt and pepper beard and a flat carpenter's pencil behind his ear, standing at the table and calmly peeling a big orange. Pol Vidal, 13: a tall, broad white striker about to burst out laughing. Laia Ferrer, 13: a white Catalan girl with a brown bun and freckles, grinning. Nil Soler, 13: a tall, very thin white boy with sticking out ears, a small spiral notebook and a pen in his hands. All in sand gold Costa Daurada training kits with a navy band.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (12) in the sand gold Costa Daurada training kit with a navy band, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, soft little afro. BriBri (14) in his faded green training jersey with number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: On the long farm table, oranges and lemons are lined up like two teams: three oranges facing two lemons, a fourth orange hidden behind them, and the biggest, shiniest orange alone in front of a small dry wrinkled lemon. Kaydoudou has stood up, chest puffed out, thumb pointing at himself. BriBri, seated, gives him a deadpan look with the hint of a smile. The whole team has turned toward Kaydoudou.
beats.location: The old stone farmhouse room at La Granja del Mar: thick stone walls, narrow windows, a long worn farm table, a white screen on a wooden beam.
beats.light: Soft grey March daylight from the narrow windows, warm reflections on the oranges.
beats.camera: Medium shot slightly above the table, the fruit line up sharp in the foreground, Kaydoudou standing behind it in the centre.
beats.alt: Devant les oranges et les citrons alignés sur la table, Kaydoudou bombe le torse et déclare qu'il est la grosse orange.

beats.anchor: Il doit baisser la tête pour passer la porte.
beats.extras: The UE Riu Ebre players, boys and girls of 13 and 14, broad shouldered and unsmiling, in red kits, stepping down from a coach in a row with their kit bags. Toni, their number 2: an enormous white Catalan boy of 14, built like an olive trunk, short dark hair, heavy jaw, ducking his head under the coach door frame as he steps down last. Laia Ferrer, 13: a white Catalan girl with a brown bun and freckles, arms crossed beside the brothers.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou (12) and BriBri (14) in the sand gold Costa Daurada kit with a navy band (BriBri number 8), Kaydoudou with his red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, BriBri with the fine shaved part on the left of his head and the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist.
beats.action: The giant Toni bends low to get out of the coach door, filling the whole doorway. In the foreground, Kaydoudou leans toward his brother's ear with a hand cupped round his mouth, eyes huge, whispering. BriBri stays calm, studying the giant. Laia raises one eyebrow.
beats.location: The gravel car park in front of the old stone farmhouse of La Granja del Mar, a parked coach, vineyards with fresh green buds and a row of pines behind.
beats.light: Bright spring morning, crisp clear light, the coach windows reflecting the sky.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle from behind the brothers' shoulders looking up at the coach door, Toni looming large in the frame.
beats.alt: Le géant Toni baisse la tête pour descendre du car, et Kaydoudou chuchote à son frère qu'on dirait une armoire avec des jambes.

beats.extras: Toni, the Riu Ebre number 2: an enormous 14 year old boy in a red kit, alone on the left side, his broad back turned, slow to turn around. A crowd of Riu Ebre players in red kits bunched on the right side of the pitch around Laia Ferrer, Jan and Èric, three Costa Daurada players of 13 in sand gold kits. In the small stand, parents lifting their chins to follow the ball, among them Papa.
beats.outfit: BriBri (14) in the sand gold Costa Daurada kit with a navy band and number 8, the fine shaved part on the left of his head, the braided blue and white bracelet on his left wrist, his kicking leg still stretched after the strike. Kaydoudou (12) in the same sand gold kit, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, up on the tips of his toes at the far left touchline. Papa (Armand) in a light blue shirt, standing in the stand.
beats.action: The ball spins high across the whole width of the pitch above the players' heads. BriBri, on the right of centre, has just struck it with the inside of his foot, body open. All the red shirts are crowded on the right; on the far left, thirty metres of empty grass, Toni alone, and Kaydoudou small and ready on tiptoe. The whole stand lifts its chin to follow the ball.
beats.location: The grass pitch of La Granja del Mar on a spring match day, a small stand, vineyards and pines around, the sea glimpsed beyond the pines.
beats.light: Clear spring afternoon, bright sun, the spinning ball catching a glint of light against the blue sky.
beats.camera: Wide high angle across the pitch, the arc of the ball drawn from BriBri on the right to Kaydoudou on the left, the crowded right side contrasting with the empty left side.
beats.alt: D'une seule touche, BriBri envoie le ballon par-dessus tout le terrain vers Kaydoudou, seul à gauche contre Toni, et toute la tribune lève le menton.
